bachelorstudent: Entry of the Qt Role combo's drop-down list. The emtk Role choice (spec 'choice' fed by role_options) lists the same 11 roles in an overlay when opened, so they are not drawn in the closed state; a role stored by another tool is appended to the list. A test compares role_options with ROLE_OPTIONS.
